mapper.select: SELECT score_id, user_id, story_id, score, create_time, update_time, nick_name, avatar, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY score DESC) AS rnk FROM ( SELECT us.score_id, us.user_id, us.story_id, us.score, us.create_time, us.update_time, u.nick_name, u.avatar FROM zhw_user_score us LEFT JOIN zhw_user u ON u.user_id = us.user_id WHERE us.story_id = #{storyId} ) t ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO zhw_user_score (user_id, story_id, score, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{storyId}, #{delta}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE score = score + #{delta}, update_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT us.score_id, us.user_id, us.story_id, us.score, us.create_time, us.update_time, u.nick_name, u.avatar, (SELECT COUNT(1) + 1 FROM zhw_user_score WHERE story_id = #{storyId} AND score > us.score) AS rnk FROM zhw_user_score us LEFT JOIN zhw_user u ON u.user_id = us.user_id WHERE us.user_id = #{userId} AND us.story_id = #{storyId} LIMIT 1
